name: omnilab/clinvar
description: Omnilab ClinVar: a variation by its VariationID or VCV accession - its name, type, germline classification, review status, conditions, genes, protein change, consequence, location, SPDI, allele frequencies, aliases - its dbSNP id as a cross-reference, its genes and conditions (Mondo, OMIM, Orphanet, HPO) as related things, and a search in ClinVar's query language, through the NCBI's E-utilities, no key needed.
